sloka: तेनैव तोरणेनाथ यक्षस्तेनाभिताडितः ।नादृश्यत तदा यक्षो भस्मीकृततनुस्तदा ।। ७.१४.२९ ॥
transliteration: tenaiva toraṇenātha yakṣastenābhitāḍitaḥ ।nādṛśyata tadā yakṣo bhasmīkṛtatanustadā ।। 7.14.29 ॥

translations.english: The Yaksha, struck by Ravana with that very archway, was then not seen, his body having been reduced to ashes.
